<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostAccepted" name="Repair costs accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostRejected" name="Repair costs not accepted"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in" sourceRef="Task_BringInComputer" targetRef="StartEvent_DefectiveComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Catch_CostCalcReceived" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostAccepted" name="Costs accepted" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Catch_CostAccepted" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostRejected" name="Costs not accepted" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRejection" targetRef="Catch_CostRejected" messageRef="Message_CostRejected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerStart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BringInComputer" name="Bring in defective computer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostCalcReceived" name="Repair cost calculation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostCalcReceived" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideCosts" name="Decide on repair costs"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerCostDecision" name="Costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAcceptance" name="Send cost acceptance" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CostAccepted" name="Cost acceptance sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRejection" name="Send cost rejection" messageRef="Message_CostRejected"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeHomeUnrepaired" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TakenHomeUnrepaired" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustStartToBringIn" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerStart" targetRef="Task_BringInComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BringInToCostCalc" sourceRef="Task_BringInComputer" targetRef="Catch_CostCalcReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostCalcToDecide" sourceRef="Catch_CostCalcReceived" targetRef="Task_DecideCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecideToGateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideCosts" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerCostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostAcceptable" name="Costs acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerCostDecision" targetRef="SendTask_SendAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptanceToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAcceptance" targetRef="EndEvent_CostAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostNotAcceptable" name="Costs not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerCostDecision" targetRef="SendTask_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectionToTakeHome" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_TakeHomeUnrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeHomeToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TakeHomeUnrepaired" targetRef="EndEvent_TakenHomeUnrepaired"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS Computer Repair" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DefectiveComputerReceived" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DefectiveComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" name="Send repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CostDecisionEvent" name="Await cost decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostAccepted" name="Cost acceptance received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostAccepted" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostRejected" name="Cost rejection received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostRejected" messageRef="Message_CostRejected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Unrepaired" name="Computer not repaired"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairFork" name="Start repair activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair activities completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorMergeBeforeCheck" name="Merge before error check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetrySelect" name="Select another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardwareAgain" name="Check and repair hardware again"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftwareAgain" name="Check and configure software again"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardwareAgain" name="Test hardware functionality after repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftwareAgain" name="Test software functionality after repair"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetestMerge" name="Merge after retry"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_DefectiveComputerReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToSendCost" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendCostToEventGw" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CostDecisionEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGwToAccepted" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecisionEvent" targetRef="Catch_CostAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGwToRejected" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecisionEvent" targetRef="Catch_CostRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToEnd" sourceRef="Catch_CostRejected" targetRef="EndEvent_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptedToFork" sourceRef="Catch_CostAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_RepairFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToHardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairFork" targetRef="Task_CheckRepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToSoftware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairFork" targetRef="Task_CheckConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareToTest" sourceRef="Task_CheckRepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareToTest" sourceRef="Task_CheckConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestHardwareToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSoftwareToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToErrorMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMergeBeforeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetestToErrorMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMergeBeforeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorMergeToCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorMergeBeforeCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorYes" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_RetrySelect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorNo" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetryToHardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RetrySelect" targetRef="Task_RepairHardwareAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetryToSoftware" sourceRef="Gateway_RetrySelect" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftwareAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareAgainToTest" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardwareAgain" targetRef="Task_TestHardwareAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareAgainToTest" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftwareAgain" targetRef="Task_TestSoftwareAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestHardwareAgainToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TestHardwareAgain" targetRef="Gateway_RetestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSoftwareAgainToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftwareAgain" targetRef="Gateway_RetestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetestMergeBack" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMergeBeforeCheck"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
